#### FAQS

## Questions teams ask before they start

What is a supply chain control tower?

A supply chain control tower — sometimes called a digital control tower — is a centralized platform that connects data from every system in your supply chain: ERP, transportation, warehousing, suppliers, into one real-time view, then layers analytics and AI on top to detect problems, diagnose causes, and recommend actions. Self-healing control towers like Syren's go further with agentic AI: they don't just predict disruptions before they occur, they take the next step and act on them automatically.

What does Syren's Supply Chain Control Tower do differently from other control towers?

Three things. First, it's custom-built to your KPIs and workflows rather than forcing you into a rigid control tower software roadmap. Second, it's powered by agentic AI throughout — predictive alerting, automated root-cause analysis, and AI agents that don't just surface insights but recommend and can execute corrective actions, all through a configurable control tower dashboard and a conversational interface your planners can query in plain English. Third, there are no long-term contract lock-ins: you modify or scale the solution as your business changes.

What are the benefits of a supply chain control tower?

A supply chain control tower delivers four core benefits: real-time, single-pane visibility across procurement, production, transportation, and delivery; faster root-cause analysis when disruptions occur, instead of manual, siloed investigation; proactive alerting that flags risks before they become delays; and stronger cross-functional alignment, since planning, manufacturing, and logistics teams work from the same data instead of conflicting reports. With Syren's Control Tower specifically, these benefits compound with Gen AI and agentic AI — teams get plain-English answers and recommended actions instead of just dashboards to interpret.

What systems does Syren's Supply Chain Control Tower integrate with?

It's ERP-agnostic. It connects to SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and other major ERPs, plus TMS, WMS, supplier portals, and external data feeds such as weather, port congestion, and carrier tracking. Data lands in a governed Databricks Lakehouse, is cleansed through our data-quality layer, and is available for analytics in near real time.

How much does Syren’s supply chain control tower cost?

Pricing depends on the number of data sources, users, and use cases in scope, so Syren scopes each engagement individually — there's no one-size-fits-all license. Because the solution is modular, most clients start with a single high-ROI use case and expand, which keeps initial investment well below a full-suite legacy control tower. Book a demo for a scoped estimate.

Who is Syren's Supply Chain Control Tower for?

It's designed for enterprise supply chain teams in retail, consumer packaged goods, healthcare and life sciences, and industrial manufacturing — particularly organizations that have data spread across disconnected systems and need decision-grade visibility without replacing their existing ERP stack.

What results have companies seen with Syren's Supply Chain Control Tower?

Syren's GenAI-powered Control Tower has delivered measurable impact across industries: a global FMCG manufacturer gained day-level visibility and faster root-cause diagnosis across 10–12 plants and production lines using causal ML-based RCA, while a pharmaceutical client achieved 30–40% faster root-cause analysis, a 20–25% reduction in analyst dependency, and 5–8% Op-Ex savings after adding a GenAI conversational layer to its existing control tower. Read the full case studies: [Smarter Manufacturing with GenAI-Powered Insights](https://syrencloud.com/case-studies/gen-ai-control-tower/) and [GenAI Conversational Control Tower.](https://syrencloud.com/case-studies/gen-ai-control-tower-implementation/)

Can agentic AI actions be reviewed or reversed?

Every autonomous action is logged with the reasoning behind it, and your team sets the approval gates, so nothing acts outside the boundaries you define.

Is agentic AI safe to use in regulated environments like pharma?

Yes. Our agentic AI operates within your compliance framework, including GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 for cold chain, and every action is auditable.
